name: Night Where Elegy Flows...
source:
This game features in humiliating heroine Anna Kobuchi who is pure about sex.

Anna has stress parameter. When it reaches its max, it is the end of humiliation.
Max value can be increased by threatening her with her virginity, her admire boyfriend, sister and a picture.

How to humiliate her is all up to you.
There await different endings based on the contents of humiliation.
You can use items to give more humiliation.

In some cases you can reach happy ending within 1 minutes after starting the game. Please enjoy!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051862.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
本作的女主角是对性十分纯洁的安娜·小渕，她将遭受各种屈辱。

安娜拥有压力值。压力值达到最大时，屈辱游戏就会结束。通过以她的处女之身、仰慕的男友、妹妹和照片进行威胁，可以提高压力值上限。

如何羞辱她，全由你决定。根据屈辱内容不同，会迎来不同结局。还可以使用道具增加屈辱值。

某些情况下，开始游戏后不到一分钟就能达成幸福结局。请尽情享受！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051862.html]DLsite English[/url]]
